meta.title: Agent roster
meta.description: A profile-wide roster of role templates with one-click team building: a "+"-menu flow that creates the member through the /roster command — recorded like /compact, with no message in the conversation and no turn of the lead — and the member stands by until given work (template prompt frozen; the model defaults to the template's and can be overridden per spawn). Includes roster_template_save / roster_template_list agent tools and an Agent roster manager in Settings. Members are ordinary subagents.
